newsitem.title: UK: All three Sept 3-5 Brent cargoes kept - trade.
newsitem.headline: All three Sept 3-5 Brent cargoes kept - trade.

text.p: All three Brent cargoes turning wet on Tuesday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargoes, nominated loading Sept 3-5 loading dates, were kept by Phibro, Shell and BP.
Two of the cargoes were deferrals from the Sept 2-4 window clocked to Shell and Sinochem on Monday.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
